content.comment_body: As several years have passed since this topic was raised, I want to revisit it. The [product_name] has an ethernet connection, and program upload/download works well. It seems logical to expect built-in email functionality without extra hardware. I am interested in sending email and/or SMS notifications when certain conditions are met. Does the latest [product_name] PLC offer native email and SMS messaging features?

Hi [user_name], Typically, sending SMS and emails with [product_name] still requires additional hardware such as [product_name] modules. Alternatively, it's possible to leverage AWS Cloud services like Amazon SES, which involves connecting [product_name] to AWS and transmitting data as needed. Another route, though more involved, is upgrading to a more advanced PLC like [version_no], which provides more extensive communication capabilities. Hope this clarifies your options.
There are other possibilities as well, for example: W&T Web-IO.
Hello, Here is an example demonstrating how to use [product_name] and AWS Cloud for this purpose: [url] Apologies, the resource is only available in German.
Here's the English version of the application note, detailing how Cloud services can process data from [product_name] and send notification emails when predefined values are reached: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks whether the current [product_name] PLC can natively send email and SMS messages via ethernet. Responders explain that direct messaging still needs extra hardware or modules, though workarounds using AWS Cloud (such as Amazon SES) can achieve email notifications without such hardware. Advancing to a higher-end PLC like [version_no] is recommended for richer communications features. The core user request for simple, built-in messaging remains unfulfilled.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] PLC to natively support email and SMS notifications using only its ethernet connection and seeks a user-friendly communication feature without any additional hardware.
